## About
Mai Vu Plumbing & Construction works out of Copeland Dr in San Antonio. We replace water heaters, fix leaks, and install kitchen appliances for homeowners around town, including jobs that come to us through Home Depot.
You might talk with Theresa, the owner, or Miguel, who handles quotes and scheduling. Out in the field you'll meet plumbers like Aaron, Jose and Martin. We like to explain the job before and after, and leave your space clean when we go.
We're open early to late every day except Wednesday. If texting is easier than a phone call, that works for us too.

## Services
- Hot water heaters: We replace hot water heaters, including ones ordered through Home Depot.
- Sink leaks: Leaks under the kitchen sink, even on a weekend. One reviewer called us on a Sunday and had the water back on that day.
- Cooktop, garbage disposal and oven installs: We install kitchen cooktops, garbage disposals and ovens, and leave the work area clean.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer emergency service?
A: Yes. One reviewer called us with a leak on a Sunday and noted that emergency service costs extra. Call and we'll talk through your situation.

Q: Can I get a quote without a visit?
A: Often, yes. We've asked customers to send photos or a video so we can look at the problem and put a quote together.

Q: Do you have payment options?
A: One reviewer said Miguel went over a quote, scheduling and payment options with them on the phone. Give us a call to ask what's available for your job.
